mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quotation_logs (quotation_id, action, total_amount, created_by, service_id) VALUES (#{quotationId}, #{action}, #{totalAmount}, #{createdBy}, #{serviceId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, quotation_id AS quotationId, action, total_amount AS totalAmount, created, created_by AS createdBy, service_id AS serviceId FROM quotation_logs WHERE quotation_id = #{quotationId} ORDER BY created DESC
